source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules 1.39: the mode a room plays (docs/design/survival-spec.md section 8.1, Leon's lobby sketch, 13 Nov 2026). A room picks one of these in its lobby (`settings.play`). The lock is this file: `available: true` opens a card; unlocking a mode is one edit, like a campaign's `listed`.

items.name: Survival
items.line: Fight from tile to tile: shops, rests, a Boss each stage. Solo or co-op, no Narrator needed.

items.name: Roguelike
items.line: Dungeons, a world map and companions.

items.name: Campaign
items.line: A written story with a Narrator.
